Executive Summary

A comprehensive Google Search Console audit was conducted for beehivestrategy.com to identify and resolve SEO issues affecting search visibility. The audit revealed critical problems including 770 missing articles from sitemaps, 648 articles missing brand suffix in title tags, 44 server errors (5xx), and Core Web Vitals INP issues. All identified issues have been fixed, deployed, and submitted to Google for re-indexing.

Fixes Implemented

1. Sitemap Regeneration

Problem: Sitemaps contained only 2,152 URLs out of 2,922 total. 770 articles were missing from the sitemaps, making them undiscoverable by Google.

Solution: Regenerated all sitemap files with proper hreflang annotations:

  • sitemap-blog-en.xml - 974 articles with hreflang alternates
  • sitemap-blog-zhcn.xml - 974 articles with hreflang alternates
  • sitemap-blog-zhtw.xml - 974 articles with hreflang alternates
  • sitemap-pages.xml - 30 static pages with hreflang alternates
  • sitemap.xml - Combined sitemap with 2,952 URLs
  • sitemap-index.xml - Index file pointing to all sub-sitemaps

2. Title Tag Brand Suffix

Problem: 648 English article HTML files were missing the "| Beehive Strategy" brand suffix in their title tags, reducing brand recognition in search results.

Solution: Automated script to add brand suffix to all title tags:

// Before: <title>Agentic AI: The Next Evolution</title>
// After:  <title>Agentic AI: The Next Evolution | Beehive Strategy</title>

3. Server Error (5xx) Fix

Problem: 44 URLs were returning 500 server errors due to middleware timeouts when converting large blog articles to markdown for AI agent requests.

Solution: Updated functions/_middleware.js with:

  • Global try-catch wrapper for all middleware operations
  • Skip markdown conversion for blog article URLs
  • Size limit for markdown conversion (skip files > 100KB)
  • Branded 500 error page with proper headers
  • Security headers on all error responses

4. Core Web Vitals INP Optimization

Problem: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) was slow due to heavy JavaScript execution blocking the main thread.

Solution: Optimized js/main.js with multiple performance improvements:

  • Reduced particle count from 150/80 to 60/30 (desktop/mobile)
  • Replaced O(n^2) particle connection algorithm with O(n) spatial grid
  • Consolidated 3 separate scroll listeners into 1 using requestAnimationFrame
  • Deferred non-critical JS execution using requestIdleCallback
  • Split initialization into critical and deferred phases

5. Blog.js Pagination Fix

Problem: js/blog.js was calling init() recursively on pagination, causing unnecessary data re-fetching and INP issues.

Solution: Extracted renderPage() function to handle pagination independently:

// Before: pagination click calls init() (re-fetches manifest)
// After:  pagination click calls renderPage() (uses cached data)

6. Daily Article Generator Update

Problem: The daily article generator was not maintaining sub-sitemaps with hreflang annotations.

Solution: Updated scripts/generate_daily_article.py to:

  • Add new article URLs to all 3 language sub-sitemaps
  • Include proper hreflang alternate links
  • Update sitemap-index.xml lastmod dates
  • Maintain the legacy combined sitemap.xml

Recommendations & Next Steps

Short-term (1-2 weeks)

  • Monitor GSC Pages report: Watch for the sitemap to be processed and URLs to move from "Discovered - currently not indexed" to "Indexed"
  • Request more indexing: Continue requesting indexing for additional unindexed articles via GSC URL Inspection (up to 10/day)
  • Check Core Web Vitals: Monitor GSC Core Web Vitals report for INP improvements after deployment
  • Review server errors: Verify the 44 previously-erroring URLs now return 200 in GSC

Medium-term (1-3 months)

  • Improve CTR: Rewrite meta descriptions for high-impression, low-CTR queries identified in GSC Performance report
  • Internal linking: Add "Related Articles" sections to improve crawl discovery and page authority distribution
  • Monitor "Crawled - not indexed": Review the 77 pages in this state for content quality issues
  • Structured data: Consider adding Article schema markup for richer search results

Ongoing

  • Daily article generator: Verify new articles are automatically added to all sub-sitemaps
  • Sitemap health: Regularly check GSC Sitemaps page for submission status and discovered URL counts
  • Performance monitoring: Use PageSpeed Insights to track Core Web Vitals trends
